hypotheses.cause: Dense short timed ASR fragments make metadata dominate source batches.
hypotheses.fix: Lossless shared source-unit grouping for >=128short timed fragments, <=256characters and15seconds per group. Original characters and every real time anchor preserved. No source batch limit raised. Explicit grouped ID namespace; legacy candidates resume original IDs.
hypotheses.boundary: Real quality and provider-call savings require full-episode acceptance, not merely grouping counts.
hypotheses.final_review: Single-mode generation now gets a single whole-source final review, matching the existing whole-source generation/initial-review context. Only an explicit provider capacity error permits one bounded partitioned fallback; valid rejection, malformed check and transport errors never trigger repartition. Segmented-mode final review remains bounded and parallel<=2. All source lines and final prose are checked.
hypotheses.quality_preserving_adjustment: Real independent checking rejected the broadened4batch inventory workload. Keep lossless ID grouping, but retain the pre-compaction fragment ownership budget for extraction and explicit segmentation. Do not silently ask each inventory call to summarize several times more meaning. Single-mode final review still reads complete source, with capacity-only fallback.

synthetic_final_policy.note: Atomic grouped-unit boundaries can create one extra source-work batch; no inventory-call-saving claim. Metadata reduction is exact; real latency remains an observation.

hypotheses.media_precision: Do not group event-level source units when screenshot or link formats are requested; retain original IDs and every event timestamp. Small ordinary sources unchanged. Media precision must not pay for podcast text compression.

hypotheses.cause: Local source correction re-evaluates unrelated positive coverage against the whole changed draft, causing cost and possible reviewer variance.
hypotheses.fix: Positive coverage certificates require unchanged source/model/options/obligation and exact cited factual prose/provenance plus complete local chapter wording/order and overview. Renderer media annotations and outer chapter container indices do not invalidate factual support. Changed local qualifications invalidate the whole local chapter. All negative receipts remain rechecked; every changed whole draft requires final independent source review. Previously covered obligations guide source correction as untrusted data.
hypotheses.synthetic: 20covered obligations,1changed paragraph:19stable certificates reused and only changed item matched; changed item remains missing. Source/model/overview changes invalidate all. Added whole-draft contradiction still blocks.
hypotheses.semantic_preservation_gate: Before applying a source correction, independently check every previously covered obligation linked to its paragraphs against original source and the entire proposed draft. Retain every source-supported material meaning. On validated loss, use only the existing second local-edit opportunity, with specific missing obligations as feedback; validate again. Still missing or malformed evidence blocks replacement. No old obligation is deleted,reclassified or marked covered by this guard; source errors are not forced into prose. Candidate changes are atomic and an unsafe old paragraph is never published as fallback.
hypotheses.contradiction_source_authority: Before changing prose to resolve a checklist contradiction, verify that obligation against primary source. Correct a false source statement and rematch the unchanged draft; retain a source-affirmed contradiction for real paragraph repair. Never compress away a contradicted obligation as incidental background. If its source validation failed, an unverified checklist cannot authorize rewriting prose; independent raw-source correction remains available.
hypotheses.raw_source_guard: Preserve every material obligation fully owned by a rewritten paragraph source range as well as its positive coverage references. This guards raw fallback, which cannot have positive summary-coverage receipts. Unsupported obligations are not forced into prose; they remain for normal source adjudication.
hypotheses.original_rejected_prose: Keep original source-rejected summary prose and bounded review feedback in engine RAM before substituting internal raw source. Correct that original prose against its actual source and owned obligations, rather than re-summarizing a large raw passage. Reject unchanged replay against the original rejected wording/evidence. Context is never part of generation_report,candidate persistence or public output; clear it after successful replacement and test disposal.
hypotheses.paired_preservation: Compare source-supported obligations against original rejected prose BEFORE and proposed whole draft AFTER in the same independent request. Block actual newly lost coverage. Already missing before-and-after obligations remain in the unchanged inventory and normal coverage repair; they are not new correction damage. One format-only retry for invalid review schema, never for a valid semantic rejection; original two local edits and160actualHTTP cap retained.

hypotheses.cause: Matcher duplicate flag for existing prose is treated as missing/unverified coverage, although duplicate judges novelty of proposed additions.
hypotheses.fix: For no proposed paragraphs only, record existing redundancy and normalize proposal-duplicate flag. Grounding rejection, contradiction, raw fallback and new duplicate-proposal vetoes remain.
hypotheses.boundary: Old two unverified items may fit this mechanism; their exact old failure messages were not retained, so historical attribution is unproven.
hypotheses.refined_hypothesis: Draft generation starts before its independent checklist exists, leaving many material conditions to repeated late repair. Broader post-compaction extraction can also make a small fresh checklist look complete while older real obligations remain absent.
hypotheses.refined_fix: For more than one source-work batch, await the complete existing inventory before drafting and pass every owned material obligation as untrusted private planning data. Verify against primary source; do not expose checklist IDs or write one paragraph per item. Keep parallel inventory workers and source-first failure checks; small single-source video retains generation/inventory overlap and exact checkpoint reuse. No extra inventory extraction pass or model call added.
hypotheses.additional_bug: Proposal-only duplicate normalization remains fixed and tested; neither real staged run hit existing_redundancy_flags, so no historical-call attribution to that branch.
hypotheses.plan_reconciliation_fix: Include obligation_ids, unmapped_obligation_ids and source_conflicts in the guided JSON example. Account every planning item as mapped, explicitly unmapped/unknown, or an evidence-bound claimed conflict. Private metadata is not source truth or semantic coverage. Reader sections, references and prefix validation remain unchanged. Repair missing private metadata once without rewriting/re-generating already valid prose. On expected private-index schema/transient failure, mark every item UNKNOWN and run the complete unchanged inventory through mandatory normal matching/source adjudication/repair and final90percent/source gates. Never hide cancellation, implementation faults, auth/quota, unrelatedAPI4xx or refusals. Small single-source video remains map-free and parallel.
hypotheses.inventory_completeness_fix: One independent source-only recall check per original source-work scope, workers2, before multi-source certified drafting. Use a dedicated recall contract rather than the first-pass compression/extraction prompt. Require explicit binding of actor/action/mechanism/setup/result/condition/attribution; a cited range or shared topic is insufficient. Each check sees source-local full obligations and a compact global known-meaning index for duplicate avoidance. Append only source-supported missing meaning, never delete/rewrite initial items. Empty valid results remain valid; any failed required recall batch blocks drafting. Extracted rows cannot self-certify materiality or approval via unrequested flags. Single-source video remains unchanged; generation mode,90percent/160HTTP/3600s unchanged.
hypotheses.pre_disposal_capture: Record successful JSON parse, actual reader-section/reference/prefix validation and known/unknown/missing private-map counts before any candidate disposal. Keep a private RAM copy of structurally valid generated prose; export only fixed labels/counts. Capture JSON-parse failure size only, never raw content. Clear all buffers. Specific format error code/reason is now allowlisted in the harness; prior lost reasons remain unknown.

hypotheses.cause: After a source correction makes coverage insufficient, an immutable whole-draft review is spent before known necessary coverage edits, then repeated after them.
hypotheses.fix: After source correction, use the one existing bounded coverage-repair opportunity before final whole-draft review. Keep source-first ordering when source safety is still unknown. Skip final review only when delivery is already impossible; never publish without final source review. Original three iterations and repair limits retained.
hypotheses.synthetic: Source repair -> matching -> coverage repair -> one final review; initially unknown unsupported prose still receives preliminary source review before correction.
hypotheses.immutable_scope_fix: Organize repaired chapters before final review, not after it. Final-review identity now includes chapter headings and paragraph order; unchanged text under a changed scope cannot reuse an old pass.
hypotheses.late_fidelity_fix: A new locatable final-source rejection can use the same existing one late-correction allowance, shared with ledger contradictions. Rejected (paragraph,text,evidence) versions are tracked by hashes; unchanged already-rejected versions cannot trigger this opportunity. Recheck actual corrected coverage and final organized whole draft; further rejections fail. Existing three iterations/two local edits unchanged.
hypotheses.transport_fix: Draft JSON is collected privately through streaming, reusing established legacy video/podcast stream handling. Terminal SSE event and full JSON/schema/source/coverage validation still required; no partial public prose or checkpoint. An explicit unsupported stream parameter may fall back once to normal JSON; a valid application/json response to a stream request is consumed without rebilling. Only one identical-input transient draft retry, shared across format attempts, no inventory regeneration or mode change. Auth, quota, refusal and unrelated4xx are not retried. Existing deadline/timeouts/request caps retained.
